target_segments: Concurrent use of a strong P-glycoprotein inhibitor or a strong OATP1B1 inhibitor.

text_span: Concurrent use of a strong P-glycoprotein inhibitor
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: concurrent exposure to a strong P-glycoprotein inhibitor is an independently evaluable pharmacologic restriction.
H1-B: strong OATP1B1 inhibitor exposure is a distinct transporter-mediated pharmacologic restriction and can independently satisfy the exclusion criterion.
